reason: A offers the clearer extension beyond prior work—flash annealing after cryo-rolling to couple negative-enthalpy-driven local chemical ordering with coherent precipitation—and specifies a direct baseline, microstructural mediators, and falsification tests. B largely restates already demonstrated heterogeneous/partially recrystallized HEA processing, while both proposals weakly justify changes in Young’s modulus and need explicit high-temperature mechanical testing.
